tasks.title: Set up Supabase project and create tables
tasks.description: Create Supabase project, configure authentication, and create database schema with tables: users, profiles, content, genres, content_genres, languages, ratings, content_ratings, watch_history, reviews, settings. Include proper indexes and foreign keys.

tasks.title: Implement content management RPC functions
tasks.description: Create Stored Procedures (RPC) for: get_content_list (with pagination, filters), get_content_by_id, get_content_by_genre, get_trending_content, get_continue_watching, get_new_releases, search_content (full-text), get_related_content, get_all_genres, get_all_languages, get_content_by_rating_range.

tasks.title: Set up storage buckets and upload logic
tasks.description: Create two storage buckets: 'videos' for video files (private) and 'thumbnails' for content thumbnails (public). Implement upload endpoints/functions: upload_video, upload_thumbnail, get_video_url, get_thumbnail_url. Set up CORS and storage policies for authorized uploads.

tasks.title: Configure Row Level Security policies
tasks.description: Create RLS policies for all tables: public users can view content but not modify; users can view their own profile; users can read/write their own watch_history and reviews; admins can manage content; profiles are private except for public display fields. Use authenticated() and current_user_id() functions.

tasks.title: Implement authentication flows
tasks.description: Configure Supabase auth with email/password, required fields (email, password, name), user signup validation, email verification, profile creation on signup, secure password policies. No auth UI needed (will be handled by React frontend SDK).

tasks.title: Create watch history tracking functions
tasks.description: Create RPC functions: start_watch_history (create new entry), update_watch_progress (update progress, timestamp), finish_watch_history (mark completed), get_watch_history, get_watch_progress (for continue watching). Store progress as percentage and last position timestamp.

tasks.title: Implement user rating and review functions
tasks.description: Create RPC functions: create_rating (validate, insert rating), update_rating (check ownership, update), delete_rating, get_user_rating, get_content_ratings (aggregate ratings, calculate average), create_review (validate, insert), update_review, delete_review, get_reviews_for_content. Require user authentication.

tasks.title: Create user settings management functions
tasks.description: Create RPC functions: get_user_settings, update_user_settings (notifications, autoplay preferences, profile visibility, language preference). Support toggleable settings: email_notifications, push_notifications, auto_play_next, show_profile_to_others, preferred_language.

tasks.title: Create seeding scripts for initial data
tasks.description: Create SQL script to seed: sample genres (Action, Comedy, Drama, Horror, Documentary, etc.), sample languages (English, Spanish, French, etc.), sample content with mock data (20-30 items) including title, description, year, duration, thumbnail URLs, video URLs, rating metadata. Use Supabase seed API or direct SQL INSERT.

tasks.title: Set up real-time subscriptions configuration
tasks.description: Configure Supabase real-time channels: 'content_updates' (trigger on content changes, notify via socket), 'watch_history_updates' (real-time progress tracking), 'rating_updates' (live rating changes). Enable real-time features for instant updates on content, progress, and ratings.

tasks.title: Create API helper utilities and types
tasks.description: Create TypeScript types matching database schema: Content, Genre, Language, Rating, Review, WatchHistory, UserProfile. Create Supabase client wrapper functions for each RPC function with proper error handling, TypeScript types, and request/response shapes matching frontend expectations.

tasks.title: Create backend configuration and environment setup
tasks.description: Create Supabase configuration file (src/lib/supabase/config.ts) with environment variable loading, initialize Supabase client with auth settings and storage URLs. Create .env.example with required variables (SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY). Create setup documentation.

tasks.title: Write integration tests for backend API
tasks.description: Create test suite for all RPC functions using Supabase Test Runner or Vitest: test content retrieval with filters, test search functionality, test watch history tracking, test rating/review CRUD operations, test settings updates, test RLS policies (with edge cases), test error handling and validation. Use mock data and edge cases.

tasks.title: Create migration scripts and version control
tasks.description: Bundle all SQL schema, RPC functions, RLS policies, storage setup, and realtime configuration into versioned migration files. Create migration directory structure with sequential migrations (01_initial_schema.sql, 02_add_watch_history.sql, etc.). Document migration steps in README.

tasks.title: Create backend API documentation
tasks.description: Document all RPC functions with: function name, parameters (typed), return values, usage examples, error codes, authentication requirements. Include schema diagrams for tables and relationships. Create API reference guide for frontend developers integrating with backend.
